# HedSpace (Agios Dimitrios, Athens)

> HedSpace designs and manufactures satellite transport, storage and handling solutions in Athens, Greece. FRAME S container: IP66, drop and vibration tested.

## Συχνές ερωτήσεις
- **What does HedSpace design and manufacture?** Specialised solutions for satellite transport, storage and handling. That covers controlled-climate satellite transfer containers, satellite interface disks, and the mounting structures, plates and adapters that attach a satellite securely to the equipment.
- **Can a container be built to custom dimensions?** Yes. There are two standard formats — Large at 3200 × 2100 × 2058 mm and Small at 1720 × 1720 × 2055 mm (FRAME S) — and custom sizes and configurations are available on request, based on the satellite, the transport conditions and the operational requirements.
- **Do you sell containers, lease them, or both?** Both. HedSpace offers satellite transport containers for sale and for lease, with configurations tailored to the needs of each mission.
- **How is the payload protected inside FRAME S?** FRAME S is rated IP66: dust-tight and protected against powerful water jets. It is drop-test certified and vibration tested, it carries pressure-relief valves for air transport, and the payload sits on a circular mounting plate on an isolated platform, behind EPDM sealing gaskets.
- **How do you reach the satellite inside FRAME S?** From the side. Two cover sections open left and right, so you do not need a high roof or overhead clearance. Each cover section weighs 60 kg and is easy to remove, disassembly is tool-free, and no torque wrench is required.
- **Do you support the equipment after delivery?** Yes. HedSpace provides inspection, maintenance and repair, as well as modifications and upgrades. Technical support continues beyond delivery.
- **Where is HedSpace based and how do I get in touch?** In Athens, Greece, at Kanari 38, Agios Dimitrios, 17341. Write to info@hedspace.eu or call +30 210 99 11 359 or +30 697 3594 143.
